description: Agitprop — the site as a 1920s poster. Red, black and aged cream only. A black header flag cut on the diagonal with a numbered 4×2 site index; a hero that shouts three imperatives (DEPLOY / INDEX / ASCEND!) stepping down the diagonal beside a lead 'film poster' whose photograph is a red-duotone montage that tears away to colour on hover; a Lissitzky red wedge and circle generated from the date that advance as you scroll; a skewed slogan ticker; staggered poster cards; a skewed black band of four sections; and the complete index as a stair-stepped ledger with Roman-numeral dates. Anton shouts, Oswald labels, Inter reads. Hard shadows, mechanical 160ms inversions, diagonal entrances.
